title: decision record D-n (.brick-harness/decisions/D-n.json)
description: An answered blocking question, written by bh-answer. A new gap of a kind and area it covers cites it (answered_by) and stops blocking.

gap.description: Id of the gap the owner answered.

source.description: file:line or tracker ref of the owner's answer.

areas.description: Paths (a directory covers what is under it) or spec/checklist area ids the answer settles.
